help:
How it works:

✍️ Confess — pick a category, send your text, confirm. A moderator reviews it and it appears in the channel as #N. You are notified.
💬 Browse — latest posts and their comment threads.
📢 Advertise — buy a sponsored post.
📜 Rules — what is and isn't allowed; request a takedown.

Commands: /delete <number> removes your own confession · /lang changes language · /cancel exits any step.

Everything is anonymous: your Telegram ID is never stored.

Staff: 📋 Queue reviews confessions, 📊 Stats, ⚙️ Admin (admins) configures everything.
